title: TableA1Response
description:
Represents a versioned snapshot of Blue Book Table A-1, containing all dataset definitions
for digital well data reporting to the Diskos National Data Repository (NDR).

version.description: The version number of this Table A-1 release (e.g., "16.0").

date.description: The release date of this version, and the date from which it is applicable for well data reporting.

datasets.description:
The list of dataset definitions included in this version of Table A-1.
Each entry describes a specific well data deliverable, its Diskos naming conventions,
file formats, and NPD requirements.

datasetId.description: Unique identifier for the dataset as defined in Blue Book Table A-1 (e.g., "01.01", "02.03").

npdRequirement.description: Indicates whether this dataset is "Mandatory" or "Optional" per NPD regulations.

dataset.description: The short name of the dataset type (e.g., "Composite", "Raw Core (Conventional)").

definition.description: A description of what the dataset contains and its purpose within the Diskos NDR.

unloadFilePath.description: The folder path template used when uploading to Diskos.

title.description:
Accepted file name patterns and formats for this dataset.
NPD prioritizes the first listed format; other formats will not be checked for readability.

exampleOfFilenames.description: Concrete examples of valid filenames for this dataset.

explanationOrExamples.description:
Additional explanation or examples clarifying naming conventions, depth references,
units, or special conditions.

infoItemGroupType.description: The Diskos INFO ITEM GROUP TYPE.

description.description:
The dataset description template as it appears in the Diskos NDR, typically including
a wellbore name placeholder.

logTitle.description:
The log curve title used for live "ONLINE" logs in Diskos.
Only applicable for log-type datasets.

creationProcess.description: The dataset creation process code in Diskos.

dataOrganisation.description: The data organisation type in Diskos.

publicAccess.description: The public access confidentiality period after which NOD releases the data (e.g., "2 years", "5 years").

publicCalculationBasedOn.description: The reference date used to calculate when the dataset becomes public.

DatasetResponse.description:
Represents a dataset entry from the Norwegian Offshore Directorate (NOD) Blue Book Table A-1,
describing attributes for digital well data reporting to the Diskos National Data Repository (NDR).
            
Each dataset corresponds to a specific type of well data deliverable and defines how it should be named, 
structured, and reported to Diskos.
